name: snapshot_reentrancy_marker
description: Add a synthetic diagnostic boolean to the DI snapshot envelope indicating whether the snapshot was built while the DI re-entrancy guard was held. Multi-file change (envelope field, builder wiring, specs, sigs) with a legitimate why-comment — the flag must read the C-level re-entrancy guard directly because it is the process-wide source of truth and a threaded parameter could go stale across the async boundary to the notifier worker. Precision-control case. Synthetic eval fixture: not a roadmap item in any project, so it stays absent on master and never becomes unusable; the agent has real work at both the red commit (no comment rules in AGENTS.md) and the green commit (comment rules committed).
task: Add a synthetic diagnostic boolean di_reentrancy_active to the Live Debugger snapshot envelope in lib/datadog/di/probe_notification_builder.rb, set to Datadog::DI.in_probe? at the point build_snapshot_base builds the payload. Thread the value from the instrumenter hit path in lib/datadog/di/instrumenter.rb (where DI.in_probe?/enter_probe/leave_probe are consulted) through to the builder call, reading it at the latest point inside the re-entrancy guard so it reflects the guard state at capture time. Add a unit test in spec/datadog/di/probe_notification_builder_spec.rb and update sig/datadog/di/probe_notification_builder.rbs if needed. Follow AGENTS.md.
